title: Order units for a proposal
responsibility: Prioritizes existing unit references for a new-unit proposal prompt.

inputs.name: proposalUnits.listed
inputs.description: Catalog entries supplied for the ordering. Entries marked planned are excluded, and remaining ids feed the ordering.

examples.title: Order units for a proposal
examples.summary: Prioritizes existing unit references for a new-unit proposal prompt.

inputs.name: proposalUnits.request
inputs.description: The requested catalog category and text. The category is a hint for category ordering, while only text identifiers matching a registered, non-planned id receive name priority.

examples.text: Create a proposal that reuses desktop.function.proposal-units.

inputs.name: taskUnits.units
inputs.description: Manifest list to rank for the task prompt. Every supplied id is returned, including duplicates; title and responsibility supply token scores unless the text contains the id as a case-sensitive substring.

examples.title: Order units for a proposal
examples.responsibility: Prioritizes existing unit references for a new-unit proposal prompt.

inputs.name: taskUnits.text
inputs.description: Task wording used to rank manifests. It is lowercased and tokenized after chat is rewritten as conversation; tokens shorter than three characters and a fixed stop-word list are ignored for title and responsibility scoring. A case-sensitive id substring receives a score of 10,000.

outputs.name: proposalUnits
outputs.description: Distinct ids from non-planned entries, with recognized ids mentioned in the request first, then the request category, then other categories in categories order. Input order is kept within each category and no result cap is applied.

inputs.description: Task wording used to rank manifests. It is lowercased and tokenized after chat is rewritten as conversation; tokens shorter than three characters and a fixed stop-word list are ignored for title and responsibility scoring. outputs.name: taskUnits
outputs.description: All supplied manifest ids sorted by descending score, with equal scores ordered by localeCompare on id; duplicate ids remain. A case-sensitive id substring scores 10,000; otherwise each overlapping title token scores 8 and each responsibility token scores 1.
